stem: Carla pays ₱8,000 a month for rent. Next year, her rent will go up by 12.5%. What will her new monthly rent be?
hints: Find the increase, which is 12.5% of ₱8,000. Then add it to the old rent.
12.5% is the easy fraction 1/8. So the increase is ₱8,000 ÷ 8.
The increase is ₱1,000. "Go up" means add it to the old rent.

solution.methodName: Percent increase or decrease: find the change, then add or subtract

steps.why: 12.5% is half of 25%, and 25% = 1/4. Half of 1/4 is 1/8.

trapNotes.₱1,000: This is only the increase. Add it to the old rent to get the new rent.
trapNotes.₱10,000: This uses 25% (₱8,000 ÷ 4 = ₱2,000). 12.5% is half of 25%, so the increase is half of ₱2,000.
trapNotes.₱7,000: This subtracts the increase. "Go up" means add.
